Title: Generally Available: Exactly Once Delivery to ADLS Gen2 Output

Body.Content:
Azure Stream Analytics supports for end-to-end exactly once semantics when writing to Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2. This significant enhancement simplifies your streaming pipeline by removing the need to monitor, implement, and troubleshoot deduplication logic. You can now rely on Stream Analytics to seamlessly handle data integrity, allowing you to focus on deriving insights from your streaming data without concerns of data loss or duplicate records.

Learn more on details and limitations.
